cohort: 60 women admitted with complications during pregnancy, childbirth, or within 42 days of postpartum, who met the World Health Organization (WHO) near-miss criteria (cases) and 60 age-group matched controls
finding: Joint family type, lack of antenatal checkups, previous history of cesarean section, first delay in seeking care, and preexisting medical disorders were identified as significant predictors of MNM.
